title: providerPickerDefaults
responsibility: The model and reasoning effort the model picker selects for a provider from the catalog.

inputs.name: pickerDefault.provider
inputs.description: The provider whose default selection is wanted, such as openai or harness-claude.

inputs.name: pickerDefault.choices
inputs.description: The catalog models of that provider, in catalog order.

outputs.name: pickerDefault
outputs.description: The model and reasoning effort to select: Opus 5.5 at xhigh for Claude when offered, else the first model and its default effort; both empty without models.
